full_page.content:
1945, December
The following is a faithful transcription of a message handwritten and typed by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
A Blessed - Peaceful Christmas.
God bless you Mr. Wollenweber - you and yours.
Sorry to hear of that old heart of yours playing truant. Do not worry about, but thank the Good God you still have such an organ to play on and keep time.
Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
DAILY COMMUNION - ALWAYS CHRISTMAS EVE.
With love and with Christmas blessings to all Comes the INFANT once more to free us from sorrow. Whose garb and Whose mien and Whose gentleness call To each heart and each soul for a manger tomorrow.
Whose Birth and Whose power and Whose wonders proclaim Him, the SON OF THE VIRGIN as promised of yore; O! May He estrange us from sin with its shame! - And reign in our hearts as His crib evermore.
TO KIOW GOD MY WONDERFULLY PRIVILEGED
PURPOSE.
God made me to know Him. 0! What a bless'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's HEAVEN BEGUN for the GRATEFUL on earth; -
- To treasure aright! ? ! HIGHEST HEAVEN its worth.
(Note from Father Solanus in Brooklyn. Dec. 1945.)
Original in possession of: Edw. P. Wollenweber 11539 Messmore Utica, MI. 48087 (Dec. 1975 - Bro. Leo.)
